arStrings.szText: Indeed! Indeed, I do! Allow me to introduce myself, I am called Khulrami. I am, well, you might consider me a demonologist. I am aware of your most formidable reputation, as I am aware of your goals.
I believe we can help each other.
I, too, am concerned about Mephisto's reappearance.
Oh, come now, don't look surprised. You'll find I am exceptionally well informed.
But to my point, I'm convinced I've found a way to harness demonic magic. Do you understand? A means to not only resist Mephisto's power, but also to amplify our own.
Our theory is that understanding and controlling demonic power is a problem of stabilization.

But by channeling demonic magic through a powerful conduit, warded with a consecrated phylactery, we can target a suitable host—a host such as yourself—with an imbuement that will both increase your resistance to demonic magic, and empower you against demons of all kinds.
Ha, no need to trouble yourself with the complexities. Especially when your role is quite simple. I will begin channeling this shrine, our conduit. Once it awakens, you need only activate it.
